title: Apollo lunar dust in Charles's lab and lunar retroreflectors

tellings.quote: I have a 200 gram or so in my lab.

plain: About 200 grams of moon dust brought back by the Apollo missions of 1969 to 1972 sits in the lab of Charles Buhler, a NASA scientist. He tells Michels so himself, "I have a 200 gram or so in my lab," and talks too about the retroreflectors, mirrors the Apollo crews left on the Moon so lasers fired from Earth can bounce back. For him, these are hard physical proof that the Moon landings happened.
